title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode4 If You Try Your Best

meta.Episode: Episode4 — If You Try Your Best

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You want to be an idol? Are you serious?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes! I'm practicing for an audition right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And where is your audition at?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I was planning on auditioning for MoriPro next!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: MoriPro?! That's a major talent agency!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you have any idea how low their acceptance rate is?! An amateur like you would be lucky to even pass their initial screening!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, uh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's your name?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Minori Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How many auditions have you had before? How'd you do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've applied about fifty times so far and passed the initial application screening about three times...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...I haven't managed to get further than that, yet...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you honestly think you have a chance at MoriPro?! I doubt you even have a shot with the smaller agencies.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Still! I want to try harder!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I dedicate myself, I'm sure I can do it! More, more, more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Things don't just happen because you really want them to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You'd be better off giving up now.
You don't seem like the idol type.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How can you say that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, stop...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You shouldn't just deny someone's dreams like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You may no longer be actively working, but you're still an idol who's meant to give everyone hope.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't like it when you say things like that, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know that!
Really, I do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even so, I'm still going to give it my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm saying that won't matter!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I have faith!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Faith?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So in order to help everyone believe things can always get better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow! Those are the words that guide me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's why I'm not ever giving up, no matter the odds! I will keep giving more until I pass! More, more!
<Hehe♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?
<Such a lovely, heartfelt speech!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Who was that?! Is somebody else up here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? My phone lit up?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's nice to meet you, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! A hologram of... Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It looks like Haruka, Airi, and Shizuku are with you. I'm glad to see you're all here♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's going on? Is Miku talking to us right now? And how does she know our names?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe! That's because I've come from a world born from all of your feelings, SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A world born from our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's right! Rin and I are actually getting ready to start a show at this very moment!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Rin is a great dancer, you know.
I even ask her for help with my moves from time to time.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With your moves? Oh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oops! The show's about to start! Gotta go!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Anyway, we'll be waiting here for you!
I hope you can all join us soon!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What was that? Some new kind of ad?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It feels a little strange actually speaking with Miku like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Um, excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, um... I just... That Miku advertisement...
Or was it an advertisement? Anyway, what Miku said made me think, um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all right? Try not to be so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right! Breathe in... Breathe out... Sorry about that.
It's just... I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it's not too much trouble, could you help me practice?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!
